verdict.rationale: The product is a processor, so background automation would normally be a wrong-axis question. However, the evidence shows AMD's GAIA framework for building AI agents that run locally on Ryzen AI hardware, which makes the agentic axis partly applicable. That evidence covers only agent building; it does not show automations that run autonomously in the background. Missing for 10: scheduled or triggered background automation, unattended or persistent agent execution, any hands-on corroboration of autonomous workflows.
